test_pybind11_class_inheritance: test pybind11 class inheritance by creating Rabbit, Dog, and Pet instances and verifying polymorphic method calls
test_pybind11_type_inspection: test pybind11 type inspection by calling check_type, get_type_of, and as_type on bound C++ classes
test_pybind11_docstrings: test pybind11 generated docstrings by inspecting UserType and NoConstructor docstrings for correct signatures and descriptions
test_pybind11_constructor_stats: test pybind11 constructor lifecycle by creating and deleting NoConstructor instances and verifying alive count with ConstructorStats
test_pybind11_duplicate_class_registrati: test pybind11 duplicate class registration errors by calling register_duplicate_class_name and register_duplicate_nested_class_name
